questions.question: Which hero from Norse mythology is known for his battle against the Midgard Serpent and is considered one of the strongest gods?
questions.explanation: Thor is the god of thunder and known for his immense strength as well as his battle against the Midgard Serpent, Jörmungandr. This encounter is a central element in Norse mythology and plays an important role in the Ragnarok narrative, the apocalyptic scenario of Norse myths.

choices: Which statement best describes the role of the informal economy in the context of urban metropolises in the Global South?

The informal economy plays a significant role in many metropolises of the Global South, creating numerous jobs, often without the security and rights provided by formal employment. This leads to a dual economy where informal and formal sectors coexist.
